title: 1. Cold-Start Learner (N=0)
description: A brand new student attempting their first question. With zero previous interactions, student features collapse to their Bayesian priors, relying on question difficulty.
student_story: First interaction on the platform. The model detects higher uncertainty and relies on problem difficulty and domain base rates.

title: 2. High Achiever (Mastery)
description: A diligent student with substantial platform practice (60 prior questions, 88% overall success) facing a familiar skill where they have consistently performed well.
student_story: High volume and high accuracy across both same-skill and cross-skill domains yield high predicted success.

title: 3. Strong Student, Weak Skill
description: A student who excels in general math (78% overall) but has repeatedly struggled on this specific target skill (only 1 out of 8 correct).
student_story: Demonstrates that same-skill history (top feature) overrides broad overall competence when predicting imminent failure.

title: 4. Skill Transfer (New Topic)
description: A competent student (35/40 correct on other skills) encountering this target skill for the very first time (0 same-skill practice).
student_story: Other-skill competence provides a positive baseline, but same-skill history collapses to the domain prior with zero practice volume.

title: 5. Near-Threshold Boundary
description: A borderline interaction situated near the operational risk threshold (tau = 0.2880), illustrating how the classification decision handles uncertainty.
student_story: A student with moderate history balancing right on the edge of the intervention trigger.
